scope: Unchanged released decoders (decodeFullAnnotator) of a transaction body or witness set of each era from Shelley to Conway at the era's decoder version (2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9), each holding a RecD record a block can hold written as a definite and an indefinite list: the update proposal (Shelley to Babbage), the execution units of a redeemer (Alonzo to Conway, list and map forms, at and over their bounds), and Conway's GovActionId (at and over the bound of its index), VotingProcedure, ProposalProcedure, Constitution and Anchor; no ledger rule, signature or script is run
referenceNode: 11.1.3 (matching embedded ledger package versions, not a bit-identical node release build)

coders.note: decodeCount (RecD cn) n reads the length around a decoder that reads nothing (482)

shelleyPParams.note: DecCBOR (Update era): RecD with no version guard (267)

exUnits.note: DecCBOR ExUnits: RecD below decoder version 12, each unit a Word64 at most maxBound :: Int64 (195-215)

alonzoTxWits.note: RedeemersRaw: decodeElement and decodeMapRedeemers read the units with decCBOR (550-597)

procedures.note: GovActionIx a Word16 (162); GovActionId (182-190), VotingProcedure (456-466), ProposalProcedure (522-533), Constitution (985-995): RecD below decoder version 12; decodeGovAction (880-895)

baseTypes.note: DecCBOR Anchor: RecD below decoder version 12 (996-1004)
